purpose: Determine whether moving the exact zero proof to the affine entry point adds significant cost on the original native queries, before broader qualification of that placement.
unchanged_workload: Use the already linked candidate binaries from both frozen trials, built from the same reproduce_rows_v1.rs with release libraries. Every run must reproduce the previously independently verified full stdout exactly.
measurement: Fresh native process wall time and child user/system CPU. This includes construction, hull, exact output validation and row serialization. Pin all runs to the same permitted CPU. Retain all preflights and samples; never extend, replace, filter or pool.
decision: Flag a reproducible cost regression for a case only when all six early/late process-wall ratios exceed 1.10 and their median exceeds 1.15. Otherwise classify this screen as inconclusive for that case. This is a placement decision, not a performance admission or general speed claim.
next_if_regression: Preserve this trial and investigate a cheaper sufficient rejection/filter before exact field arithmetic; retain full native inputs and exact zero capability.
excluded: Formal proof or broad qualification of the early candidate
Runtime admission or full plan completion
